results.content: Your AI coding agent sees files. Not the system. And that's a problem. Because a real codebase isn't a folder of files. It's tens of thousands of symbols tangled across packages, repos, and dependencies. Agents that grep their way through it miss dependencies, break call chains, and ship blind edits. GitNexus (Akon Labs (YC S26)) fixes that. And it launched today. GitNexus is a Knowledge Graph Kernel that unifies every codebase in your org into one source of truth your coding agents can query. It resolves your code into a deterministic graph — so agents get exact callers, imports, and impact instead of embedding guesses. Here's what that actually looks like: → Resolved call chains user.address.getCity().save() resolves at every hop. No embedding guesswork. A knowledge graph, precomputed.
